# rustfs_pools Data Source

List all RustFS storage pools, with availability, capacity and metadata-freshness diagnostics on servers that report them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rustfs_pools" "all" {}

output "pool_names" {
  value = data.rustfs_pools.all.names
}

output "pool_diagnostics" {
  value = data.rustfs_pools.all.pools
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) List of storage pool names.
- `pools` (Attributes List) One entry per storage pool, in the order the server reports them. The diagnostic attributes are null when the server does not send them (RustFS before 1.0.5). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `availability` (String) Pool availability: `online`, `offline` or `unknown`. Null on servers before RustFS 1.0.5.
- `capacity_status` (String) Capacity state: `live`, `partial` or `unknown`. Null on servers before RustFS 1.0.5.
- `name` (String) Storage pool name: the command line the pool was started with.
- `observed_at` (String) When the server sampled these diagnostics (RFC3339). Null on servers before RustFS 1.0.5.
- `pool_metadata_status` (String) Metadata freshness of the pool. Null on servers before RustFS 1.0.5.
- `rebalance_metadata_status` (String) Metadata freshness of the rebalance state. Null on servers before RustFS 1.0.5.
- `status` (String) Pool status the server reports.
